text:
marie: PTAL — addressed comments from earlier review. Rebased onto main and split out the helper into test_utils.py. Added unit for the off-by-one in shard backoff.

marie: commands I ran locally:
```
pytest tests/test_shard_backoff.py -q
./scripts/smoke.sh --shard 3
```

tj: looks good from my side; only tiny nit on variable name in test_utils (s/idx/slot/) :+1:

marie: fixed that and ran linters. pushed a new commit, CI should pick up.

ci-bot: Build queued for commit abc123 (jobs: unit, lint)

sahil: heads-up — canary window opens 2024-05-10 10:00 PT. If you want today’s slot we need to merge by 09:00 PT to reserve.

marie: I can merge as soon as CI is green; aiming for 08:45 PT. @alex can you give final eyes in next hour?

alex: will review in ~45m, ping me if CI is green earlier.

rohit: quick question — any perf/regression concerns? Did you run the load smoke?

marie: ran a light load smoke; no perf regressions observed. Added perf flag to smoke script (see commit message). No behavioral changes to runtime.

alex: LGTM, nice unit coverage and tidy commits. :shipit:

marie: thanks! merging after CI passes, will schedule canary per ops playbook. Ping me if anything flakey.
